zh: 善或惡　消滅這個物品 — 若你有一個名為 Jafar 的角色在場，抽兩張牌。若你有一個名為 Genie 的角色在場，將一個費用 4 或以下的指定角色移回其持有者的手牌。

name: The Sorcerer's Hat
en:
INCREDIBLE ENERGY ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Name a card, then reveal the
top card of your deck. If it's the named card, put that card
into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the top of your deck.
zh: 不可思議的能量　⟳，1 ⬡ — 說出一張卡的名稱，然後展示你牌庫頂的卡。若它是說出的卡，將它加入你的手牌；否則，將它放到你牌庫頂。

name: The Queen's Castle - Mirror Chamber
en:
USING THE MIRROR At the start of your turn, for each character you have here,
you may draw a card.
zh: 使用鏡子　在你的回合開始時，你這裡每有一個角色，你就可以抽一張牌。

name: The Sorcerer's Tower - Wondrous Workspace
en:
BROOM CLOSET Your characters named Magic Broom may move here for free.
MAGICAL POWER Characters get +1 ◊ while here.
zh:
掃帚間　你名為 Magic Broom 的角色可以免費移動到這裡。
魔法力量　角色在這裡時獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Cubby - Mighty Lost Boy
en:
THE BEAR Whenever this character moves to a
location, he gets +3 ¤ this turn.
zh: 熊　每當這個角色移動到一個地點時，他本回合獲得 +3 ¤。

name: Cursed Merfolk - Ursula's Handiwork
en:
POOR SOULS Whenever this character is challenged,
each opponent chooses and discards a card.
zh: 可憐的靈魂　每當這個角色被挑戰時，每位對手選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Don Karnage - Prince of Pirates
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Flotsam - Riffraff
en:
EERIE PAIR Your characters named Jetsam get
+3 ¤.
zh: 詭異的一對　你名為 Jetsam 的角色獲得 +3 ¤。

name: Friar Tuck - Priest of Nottingham
en:
YOU THIEVING SCOUNDREL When you play this
character, the player or players with the most
cards in their hand chooses and discards a card.
zh: 你這偷竊的無賴　當你打出這個角色時，手牌最多的玩家選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Helga Sinclair - Femme Fatale
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Helga Sinclair.)
THIS CHANGES EVERYTHING Whenever this
character quests, you may deal 3 damage to
chosen damaged character.
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Helga Sinclair 的角色上。）
這改變了一切　每當這個角色探險時，你可以對指定的受傷角色造成 3 點傷害。

name: Helga Sinclair - Vengeful Partner
en:
NOTHING PERSONAL When this character is
challenged and banished, banish the challenging
character.
zh: 不是針對你　當這個角色被挑戰並消滅時，消滅進行挑戰的角色。

name: Jetsam - Riffraff
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to
challenge.)
EERIE PAIR Your characters named Flotsam gain Ward.
zh:
守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）
詭異的一對　你名為 Flotsam 的角色獲得守護。

name: Kit Cloudkicker - Tough Guy
en:
SKYSURFING When you play this character, you
may return chosen opposing character with 2 ¤
or less to their player's hand.
zh: 空中衝浪　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將一個 2 ¤ 或以下的指定對方角色移回其持有者的手牌。

name: Lyle Tiberius Rourke - Cunning Mercenary
en:
WELL, NOW YOU KNOW When you play this character,
chosen opposing character gains Reckless during their
next turn. (They can't quest and must challenge if able.)
THANKS FOR VOLUNTEERING Whenever one of your
other characters is banished, each opponent loses 1 lore.
zh:
好，現在你知道了　當你打出這個角色時，指定的對方角色在其下個回合獲得魯莽。（他們不能探險，且若有能力必須挑戰。）
謝謝你自願　每當你另一個角色被消滅時，每位對手失去 1 點傳說值。

name: Milo Thatch - King of Atlantis
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Milo Thatch.)
TAKE THEM BY SURPRISE When this character is
banished, return all opposing characters to their
players' hands.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Milo Thatch 的角色上。）
出其不意　當這個角色被消滅時，將所有對方角色移回其持有者的手牌。

name: Morph - Space Goo
en:
MIMICRY You may play any character with Shift on
this character as if this character had any name.
zh: 擬態　你可以視同這個角色具有任何名稱般，在這個角色上打出任何具變身的角色。

name: Peter Pan - Lost Boy Leader
en:
I CAME TO LISTEN TO THE STORIES Once per turn,
when this character moves to a location, gain lore
equal to that location's ◊.
zh: 我是來聽故事的　每回合一次，當這個角色移動到一個地點時，獲得等同該地點 ◊ 的傳說值。

name: Prince John - Phony King
en:
COLLECT TAXES Whenever this character quests,
each opponent with more lore than you loses 2 lore.
zh: 收稅　每當這個角色探險時，每個傳說值比你多的對手失去 2 點傳說值。

name: Shenzi - Hyena Pack Leader
en:
I'LL HANDLE THIS While this character is at a location, she
gets +3 ¤.
WHAT'S THE HURRY? While this character is at a location,
whenever she challenges another character, you may draw
a card.
zh:
這個交給我　當這個角色在地點時，她獲得 +3 ¤。
急什麼？　當這個角色在地點時，每當她挑戰另一個角色時，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Sir Hiss - Aggravating Asp
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Skippy - Energetic Rabbit
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
zh: 守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）

name: Stitch - Covert Agent
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
HIDE While this character is at a location, he gains
Ward. (Opponents can't choose them except to
challenge.)
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
躲藏　當這個角色在地點時，他獲得守護。（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇他們。）

name: Ursula - Deceiver
en:
YOU'LL NEVER EVEN MISS IT When you play this
character, chosen opponent reveals their hand
and discards a song card of your choice.
zh: 你根本不會想念它　當你打出這個角色時，指定對手展示其手牌並棄掉一張你選擇的歌曲卡。

name: Ursula - Deceiver of All
en:
WHAT A DEAL Whenever this character sings a song,
you may play that song again from your discard for
free. If you do, put that card on the bottom of your
deck instead of into your discard.
zh: 真划算　每當這個角色詠唱一首歌時，你可以從你的棄牌堆免費再打出那首歌。若你這麼做，將那張卡放到你牌庫底而非棄牌堆。

name: Wildcat - Mechanic
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
DISASSEMBLE ⟳ — Banish chosen item.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
拆解　⟳ — 消滅指定的物品。

name: Zazu - Steward of the Pride Lands
en:
IT'S TIME TO GO! While this character is at a
location, he gets +1 ◊.
zh: 該走了！　當這個角色在地點時，他獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Has Set My Heaaaaaaart...
en:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Banish chosen item.
zh:
（費用 2 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
消滅指定的物品。

name: I Will Find My Way
en:
(A character with cost 1 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Chosen character of yours gets +2 ¤ this turn. They may move to
a location for free.
zh:
（費用 1 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
你一個指定角色本回合獲得 +2 ¤。他們可以免費移動到一個地點。

name: Strike a Good Match
en:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Draw 2 cards, then choose and discard a card.
zh:
（費用 2 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
抽兩張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Airfoil
en:
I GOT TO BE GOING ⟳ — If you've played 2 or more
actions this turn, draw a card.
zh: 我得走了　⟳ — 若你本回合打出過 2 個或以上的行動，抽一張牌。

name: Robin's Bow
en:
FOREST'S GIFT ⟳ — Deal 1 damage to chosen damaged
character or location.
A BIT OF A LARK Whenever a character of yours named Robin
Hood quests, you may ready this item.
zh:
森林的恩賜　⟳ — 對指定的受傷角色或地點造成 1 點傷害。
有點像雲雀　每當你一個名為 Robin Hood 的角色探險時，你可以準備這個物品。

name: Starlight Vial
en:
EFFICIENT ENERGY ⟳ — You pay 2 ⬡ less for the next
action you play this turn.
TRAP 2 ⬡, Banish this item — Draw 2 cards, then choose
and discard a card.
zh:
高效能量　⟳ — 你本回合打出的下一個行動少支付 2 ⬡。
陷阱　2 ⬡，消滅這個物品 — 抽兩張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Fang - River City
en:
SURROUNDED BY WATER Characters gain Ward and Evasive while here. (Opponents can't
choose them except to challenge. Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
zh: 被水環繞　角色在這裡時獲得守護和迴避。（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇他們。只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Kuzco's Palace - Home of the Emperor
en:
CITY WALLS Whenever a character is challenged and banished while here, banish the
challenging character.
zh: 城牆　每當有角色在這裡被挑戰並消滅時，消滅進行挑戰的角色。

name: Ariel - Adventurous Collector
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
INSPIRING VOICE Whenever you play a song, chosen
character of yours gains Evasive until the start of your next
turn.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
激勵之聲　每當你打出一首歌時，你一個指定角色獲得迴避，直到你的下個回合開始。

name: Captain Hook - Master Swordsman
en:
NEMESIS During your turn, whenever this character
banishes another character in a challenge, ready this
character. He can't quest for the rest of this turn.
MAN-TO-MAN Characters named Peter Pan lose
Evasive and can't gain Evasive.
zh:
宿敵　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，準備這個角色。他本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。
單挑　名為 Peter Pan 的角色失去迴避且不能獲得迴避。

name: Della Duck - Unstoppable Mom
en:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
zh: 魯莽（這個角色不能探險，且每回合若有能力必須挑戰。）

name: HeiHei - Accidental Explorer
en:
MINDLESS WANDERING Once per turn, when this
character moves to a location, each opponent
loses 1 lore.
zh: 漫無目的的遊蕩　每回合一次，當這個角色移動到一個地點時，每位對手失去 1 點傳說值。

name: Hydra - Deadly Serpent
en:
WATCH THE TEETH Whenever this character
takes damage, deal that much damage to chosen
opposing character.
zh: 小心牙齒　每當這個角色受到傷害時，對指定的對方角色造成等量的傷害。

name: Jim Hawkins - Space Traveler
en:
THIS IS IT! When you play this character, you may play a
location with cost 4 or less for free.
TAKE THE HELM Whenever you play a location, this
character may move there for free.
zh:
就是這個！　當你打出這個角色時，你可以免費打出一個費用 4 或以下的地點。
掌舵　每當你打出一個地點時，這個角色可以免費移動到那裡。

name: Kakamora - Menacing Sailor
en:
PLUNDER When you play this character, each
opponent loses 1 lore.
zh: 掠奪　當你打出這個角色時，每位對手失去 1 點傳說值。

name: Madame Medusa - The Boss
en:
THAT TERRIBLE WOMAN When you play this
character, banish chosen opposing character with
3 ¤ or less.
zh: 那個可怕的女人　當你打出這個角色時，消滅一個 3 ¤ 或以下的指定對方角色。

name: Maui - Soaring Demigod
en:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must challenge
each turn if able.)
IN MA BELLY Whenever a character of yours named
HeiHei quests, this character gets +1 ◊ and loses
Reckless this turn.
zh:
魯莽（這個角色不能探險，且每回合若有能力必須挑戰。）
在我肚子裡　每當你一個名為 HeiHei 的角色探險時，這個角色本回合獲得 +1 ◊ 並失去魯莽。

name: Maui - Whale
en:
THIS MISSION IS CURSED This character can't
ready at the start of your turn.
I GOT YOUR BACK 2 ⬡ — Ready this character.
He can't quest for the rest of this turn.
zh:
這任務被詛咒了　這個角色在你的回合開始時不能準備。
我挺你　2 ⬡ — 準備這個角色。他本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Milo Thatch - Spirited Scholar
en:
I'M YOUR MAN! While this character is at a
location, he gets +2 ¤.
zh: 我是你要的人！　當這個角色在地點時，他獲得 +2 ¤。

name: Moana - Born Leader
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Moana.)
WELCOME TO MY BOAT Whenever this character
quests while at a location, ready all other characters
here. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Moana 的角色上。）
歡迎上我的船　每當這個角色在地點探險時，準備這裡所有其他角色。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Moana - Undeterred Voyager
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Peter Pan - Never Land Hero
en:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're
played.)
OVER HERE, TINK While you have a character named
Tinker Bell in play, this character gets +2 ¤.
zh:
突襲（這個角色在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）
這裡，Tink　當你有一個名為 Tinker Bell 的角色在場時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。

name: Peter Pan - Pirate's Bane
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Peter Pan.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
YOU'RE NEXT! Whenever he challenges a Pirate character,
this character takes no damage from the challenge.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Peter Pan 的角色上。）
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
下一個就是你！　每當他挑戰一個海盜角色時，這個角色不受該次挑戰的傷害。

name: Prince Eric - Expert Helmsman
en:
SURPRISE MANEUVER When this character is
banished, you may banish chosen character.
zh: 出其不意的機動　當這個角色被消滅時，你可以消滅指定角色。

name: Scroop - Backstabber
en:
BRUTE While this character has damage, he gets
+3 ¤.
zh: 蠻力　當這個角色有傷害時，他獲得 +3 ¤。

name: Slightly - Lost Boy
en:
THE FOX If you have a character named Peter Pan in
play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this character.
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
zh:
狐狸　若你有一個名為 Peter Pan 的角色在場，你打出這個角色時少支付 1 ⬡。
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Stitch - Little Rocket
en:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
zh: 突襲（這個角色在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）

name: Trigger - Not-So-Sharp Shooter
en: OLD BETSY Your characters named Nutsy get +1 ◊.
zh: 老貝琪　你名為 Nutsy 的角色獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Divebomb
en:
Banish one of your characters with Reckless to banish
chosen character with less ¤ than that character.
zh: 消滅你一個具魯莽的角色，來消滅一個 ¤ 比該角色低的指定角色。

name: I've Got a Dream
en:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Ready chosen character of yours at a location. They can't quest
for the rest of this turn. Gain lore equal to that location's ◊.
zh:
（費用 2 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
準備你一個在地點的指定角色。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。獲得等同該地點 ◊ 的傳說值。

name: On Your Feet! Now!
en:
Ready all your characters and deal 1 damage to each of
them. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.
zh: 準備你所有的角色並對他們每個造成 1 點傷害。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Voyage
en:
Move up to 2 characters of yours to the same location
for free.
zh: 將你至多 2 個角色免費移動到同一個地點。

name: Maui's Fish Hook
en:
IT'S MAUI TIME! If you have a character named Maui in play,
you may use this item's Shapeshift ability for free.
SHAPESHIFT ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Choose one:
• Chosen character gains Evasive until the start of your next
turn. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
• Chosen character gets +3 ¤ this turn.
zh:
該 Maui 出場了！　若你有一個名為 Maui 的角色在場，你可以免費使用這個物品的變形能力。
變形　⟳，2 ⬡ — 選擇一項：
• 指定角色獲得迴避，直到你的下個回合開始。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）
• 指定角色本回合獲得 +3 ¤。

name: Sumerian Talisman
en:
SOURCE OF MAGIC During your turn, whenever one of your
characters is banished in a challenge, you may draw a card.
zh: 魔法源頭　在你的回合中，每當你一個角色在挑戰中被消滅時，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Jolly Roger - Hook's Ship
en:
LOOK ALIVE, YOU SWABS! Characters gain Rush while here. (They can challenge
the turn they're played.)
ALL HANDS ON DECK! Your Pirate characters may move here for free.
zh:
打起精神，水手們！　角色在這裡時獲得突襲。（他們在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）
全員上甲板！　你的海盜角色可以免費移動到這裡。

name: RLS Legacy - Solar Galleon
en:
THIS IS OUR SHIP Characters gain Evasive while here. (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge them.)
HEAVE TOGETHER NOW If you have a character here, you pay 2 ⬡ less to move a
character of yours here.
zh:
這是我們的船　角色在這裡時獲得迴避。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）
一起用力　若你這裡有一個角色，你將角色移動到這裡時少支付 2 ⬡。

name: Audrey Ramirez - The Engineer
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
SPARE PARTS Whenever this character quests,
ready one of your items.
zh:
守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）
備用零件　每當這個角色探險時，準備你一個物品。

name: Captain Amelia - First in Command
en:
DISCIPLINE During your turn, this character gains
Evasive. (They can challenge characters with
Evasive.)
zh: 紀律　在你的回合中，這個角色獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: Dewey - Showy Nephew
en:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you
may add their ¤ to another chosen character's
¤ this turn.)
zh: 支援（每當這個角色探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Flintheart Glomgold - Lone Cheater
en:
THEY'LL NEVER SEE IT COMING! During your turn,
this character gains Evasive. (They can challenge
characters with Evasive.)
zh: 他們不會料到！　在你的回合中，這個角色獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: Gramma Tala - Keeper of Ancient Stories
en:
THERE WAS ONLY OCEAN When you play this
character, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You

變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Peter Pan 的角色上。）
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
下一個就是你！　每當他挑戰一個海盜角色時，這個角色不受該次挑戰的傷害。

name: RLS Legacy - Solar Galleon
en:
THIS IS OUR SHIP Characters gain Evasive while here. (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge them.)
HEAVE TOGETHER NOW If you have a character here, you pay 2 ⬡ less to move a
character of yours here.
zh:
這是我們的船　角色在這裡時獲得迴避。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）
一起用力　若你這裡有一個角色，你將角色移動到這裡時少支付 2 ⬡。

name: Gramma Tala - Spirit of the Ocean
en:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Gramma Tala.)
DO YOU KNOW WHO YOU ARE? Whenever a card is
put into your inkwell, gain 1 lore.
zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Gramma Tala 的角色上。）
你知道你是誰嗎？　每當有卡被放入你的墨水池時，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Scrooge McDuck - Richest Duck in the World
en:
I'M GOING HOME! During your turn, this character
gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters with
Evasive.)
I DIDN'T GET RICH BY BEING STUPID During your turn,
whenever this character banishes another character
in a challenge, you may play an item for free.
zh:
我要回家了！　在你的回合中，這個角色獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）
我不是靠愚蠢致富的　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，你可以免費打出一個物品。

name: Belle's House - Maurice's Workshop
en: LABORATORY If you have a character here, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play items.
zh: 實驗室　若你這裡有一個角色，你打出物品時少支付 1 ⬡。

name: Mickey Mouse - Trumpeter
en: SOUND THE CALL ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Play a character for free.
zh: 吹響號角　⟳，2 ⬡ — 免費打出一個角色。

name: Robin Hood - Champion of Sherwood
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Robin Hood.)
SKILLED COMBATANT During your turn, whenever this
character banishes another character in a challenge, gain 2 lore.
THE GOOD OF OTHERS When this character is banished in a
challenge, you may draw a card.
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Robin Hood 的角色上。）
熟練的戰士　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，獲得 2 點傳說值。
為了他人　當這個角色在挑戰中被消滅時，你可以抽一張牌。

name: And Then Along Came Zeus
zh:

對指定角色或地點造成 5 點傷害。

name: Piglet - Pooh Pirate Captain
en:
AND I'M THE CAPTAIN! While you have 2 or more
other characters in play, this character gets +2 ◊.
zh: 而我是船長！　當你另有 2 個或以上的角色在場時，這個角色獲得 +2 ◊。
